<!-- The engine runs in Web Workers (and once in the page for queries). -->
<script type="text/plain" id="engine">
globalThis.ENGINE = (function(){
"use strict";
var V = null, Q = null, SC = null, DIM = 256, ROWS = 0;
var UNK = 1, MAXTOK = 512, MAXWORD = 100;
var X = null;          /* WebAssembly exports (embed.c) */

async function initModel(m){
  V = new Map();
  for (var i = 0; i < m.vocab.length; i++) V.set(m.vocab[i], i);
  Q = m.q; SC = m.sc; DIM = m.dim; ROWS = m.rows;
  if (m.wasm){
    try {
      var inst = await WebAssembly.instantiate(m.wasm, {});
      X = inst.exports || inst.instance.exports;
      var vb = new TextEncoder().encode(m.vocab.join("\n"));
      var vp = X.alloc(vb.length); new Uint8Array(X.memory.buffer, vp, vb.length).set(vb);
      var qp = X.alloc(Q.length); new Int8Array(X.memory.buffer, qp, Q.length).set(Q);
      var sp = X.alloc(SC.length * 4); new Float32Array(X.memory.buffer, sp, SC.length).set(SC);
      if (X.init(vp, vb.length, ROWS, DIM, qp, sp) !== ROWS) X = null;
    } catch (e) { X = null; }
  }
  return !!X;
}

/* ---- JavaScript tokenizer (used for non-ASCII text and queries) ---- */
var CC = new Uint8Array(128);
for (var c = 0; c < 128; c++){
  if (c === 9 || c === 10 || c === 13 || c === 32) CC[c] = 1;
  else if (c < 32 || c === 127) CC[c] = 3;
  else if ((c >= 33 && c <= 47) || (c >= 58 && c <= 64) || (c >= 91 && c <= 96) || (c >= 123 && c <= 126)) CC[c] = 2;
}
var RE_NONASCII = /[^\x00-\x7f]/, RE_ASCII = /^[\x00-\x7f]*$/;
var RE_ACTRL = /[\x00-\x08\x0b\x0c\x0e-\x1f\x7f]/, RE_ACTRL_G = /[\x00-\x08\x0b\x0c\x0e-\x1f\x7f]/g;
var RE_CTRL = /\p{C}/u, RE_WS = /\p{White_Space}/u, RE_MN = /\p{Mn}/gu, RE_P = /\p{P}/u;
function isCJK(c){
  return (c>=0x4E00&&c<=0x9FFF)||(c>=0x3400&&c<=0x4DBF)||(c>=0x20000&&c<=0x2A6DF)||(c>=0x2A700&&c<=0x2B73F)||
         (c>=0x2B740&&c<=0x2B81F)||(c>=0x2B820&&c<=0x2CEAF)||(c>=0xF900&&c<=0xFAFF)||(c>=0x2F800&&c<=0x2FA1F);
}
function normalizeSlow(t){
  var out = "";
  for (var ch of t){
    var c = ch.codePointAt(0);
    if (c < 128){ var k = CC[c]; if (k === 3) continue; out += k === 1 ? " " : ch; continue; }
    if (c === 0xFFFD) continue;
    if (RE_CTRL.test(ch)) continue;
    if (RE_WS.test(ch)){ out += " "; continue; }
    if (isCJK(c)){ out += " " + ch + " "; continue; }
    out += ch;
  }
  out = out.normalize("NFD").replace(RE_MN, "");
  var low = "";
  for (var ch2 of out) low += ch2.toLowerCase();   /* per char, like Rust: no final-sigma rule */
  return low;
}
var WP = new Map();
function wordPiece(word, ids){
  var hit = WP.get(word);
  if (hit === undefined){
    var ascii = RE_ASCII.test(word), chars = ascii ? null : Array.from(word), len = ascii ? word.length : chars.length;
    if (len > MAXWORD) hit = [UNK];
    else {
      hit = [];
      var start = 0;
      while (start < len){
        var end = len, found = -1;
        while (start < end){
          var sub = ascii ? word.slice(start, end) : chars.slice(start, end).join("");
          var id = V.get(start > 0 ? "##" + sub : sub);
          if (id !== undefined){ found = id; break; }
          end--;
        }
        if (found < 0){ hit = [UNK]; break; }
        hit.push(found); start = end;
      }
    }
    if (WP.size > 300000) WP.clear();
    WP.set(word, hit);
  }
  for (var i = 0; i < hit.length; i++) ids.push(hit[i]);
}
function tokenize(text){
  var ids = [], t, i, start = -1, c, n;
  if (!RE_NONASCII.test(text)){
    t = RE_ACTRL.test(text) ? text.replace(RE_ACTRL_G, "") : text; n = t.length;
    for (i = 0; i < n && ids.length < MAXTOK; i++){
      c = t.charCodeAt(i);
      var k = CC[c];
      if (k === 0){ if (start < 0) start = i; continue; }
      if (start >= 0){ wordPiece(t.slice(start, i).toLowerCase(), ids); start = -1; }
      if (k === 2) wordPiece(t[i], ids);
    }
    if (start >= 0 && ids.length < MAXTOK) wordPiece(t.slice(start).toLowerCase(), ids);
  } else {
    t = normalizeSlow(text); n = t.length;
    for (i = 0; i < n && ids.length < MAXTOK; ){
      c = t.codePointAt(i);
      var w = c > 0xFFFF ? 2 : 1, sp, pu;
      if (c < 128){ sp = CC[c] === 1; pu = CC[c] === 2; } else { sp = false; pu = RE_P.test(t.slice(i, i + w)); }
      if (!sp && !pu){ if (start < 0) start = i; i += w; continue; }
      if (start >= 0){ wordPiece(t.slice(start, i), ids); start = -1; }
      if (pu) wordPiece(t.slice(i, i + w), ids);
      i += w;
    }
    if (start >= 0 && ids.length < MAXTOK) wordPiece(t.slice(start), ids);
  }
  return ids.length > MAXTOK ? ids.slice(0, MAXTOK) : ids;
}
function embed(text){
  var ids = tokenize(text), v = new Float32Array(DIM), n = 0;
  for (var j = 0; j < ids.length; j++){
    var id = ids[j];
    if (id === UNK) continue;
    var o = id * DIM, s = SC[id];
    for (var k = 0; k < DIM; k++) v[k] += Q[o + k] * s;
    n++;
  }
  if (!n) return null;
  var ss = 0;
  for (var k2 = 0; k2 < DIM; k2++) ss += v[k2] * v[k2];
  ss = Math.sqrt(ss);
  if (!ss) return null;
  for (var k3 = 0; k3 < DIM; k3++) v[k3] /= ss;
  return v;
}

/* ---- WebAssembly batch: ASCII passages -> int8 vectors ---- */
var WCAP = 0, WT = 0, WO = 0, WV = 0, WK = 0, WN = 0, ENC = new TextEncoder();
function wasmBatch(passages){
  var total = 0, n = passages.length, i;
  for (i = 0; i < n; i++) total += passages[i].length;
  if (total > WCAP || n > WN){
    WCAP = Math.max(total, WCAP, 1 << 22); WN = Math.max(n, WN, 8192);
    WT = X.alloc(WCAP); WO = X.alloc((WN + 1) * 4); WV = X.alloc(WN * DIM); WK = X.alloc(WN);
    if (!WT || !WO || !WV || !WK) throw new Error("out of memory");
  }
  var mem = new Uint8Array(X.memory.buffer), offs = new Uint32Array(X.memory.buffer, WO, n + 1), o = 0;
  for (i = 0; i < n; i++){ offs[i] = o; o += ENC.encodeInto(passages[i], mem.subarray(WT + o, WT + WCAP)).written; }
  offs[n] = o;
  X.embed_batch(WT, WO, n, WV, WK);
  return {vecs: new Int8Array(X.memory.buffer, WV, n * DIM), ok: new Uint8Array(X.memory.buffer, WK, n)};
}

/* ---- file kinds: only these are opened ---- */
var KIND = {txt: "text", md: "text", markdown: "text", csv: "text", pdf: "pdf", docx: "docx", pptx: "pptx", xlsx: "xlsx", doc: "doc", xls: "xls", ppt: "ppt", zip: "zip", msg: "msg"};
"js mjs cjs ts tsx jsx py java c h cpp hpp cc cs go rs rb php swift kt kts scala sh bash zsh ps1 bat sql r m lua pl dart jl hs ml ex exs zig f90 tex".split(" ").forEach(function(e){ KIND[e] = "code"; });
function extOf(n){ var i = n.lastIndexOf("."); return i > 0 ? n.slice(i + 1).toLowerCase() : ""; }
function kindOf(name){ return KIND[extOf(name)] || null; }
function skipDir(name){ return false; }

/* ---- readers ---- */
function decodeText(u8){
  if (u8[0] === 0xFF && u8[1] === 0xFE) return new TextDecoder("utf-16le").decode(u8);
  if (u8[0] === 0xFE && u8[1] === 0xFF) return new TextDecoder("utf-16be").decode(u8);
  if (u8.subarray(0, 4096).indexOf(0) >= 0) return null;
  var t = new TextDecoder("utf-8").decode(u8);
  var bad = (t.slice(0, 20000).match(/\uFFFD/g) || []).length;
  return bad > 20 ? new TextDecoder("windows-1252").decode(u8) : t;
}
function decodeEnt(s){
  return s.replace(/&(#x[0-9a-f]+|#\d+|amp|lt|gt|quot|apos|nbsp);/gi, function(m, g){
    g = g.toLowerCase();
    if (g[0] === "#"){ var n = g[1] === "x" ? parseInt(g.slice(2), 16) : parseInt(g.slice(1), 10); return n > 0 && n < 0x110000 ? String.fromCodePoint(n) : " "; }
    return {amp:"&", lt:"<", gt:">", quot:'"', apos:"'", nbsp:" "}[g];
  });
}
function xmlText(x, paraTags){
  var re = new RegExp("</(?:" + paraTags + ")>|<(?:w:tab|w:br|a:br)\\b[^>]*/?>", "g");
  return decodeEnt(x.replace(re, "\n").replace(/<[^>]+>/g, "")).replace(/[ \t]+/g, " ").replace(/\n{3,}/g, "\n\n");
}
async function inflateRaw(bytes){
  var st = new Blob([bytes]).stream().pipeThrough(new DecompressionStream("deflate-raw"));
  return new Uint8Array(await new Response(st).arrayBuffer());
}
/* zip on a Blob: reads only the directory and the entries that are needed (zip64 too) */
function u64(dv, o){ return dv.getUint32(o, true) + dv.getUint32(o + 4, true) * 4294967296; }
async function zipEntries(blob){
  var tl = Math.min(blob.size, 65536 + 22 + 20);
  var tail = new DataView(await blob.slice(blob.size - tl).arrayBuffer()), e = -1, i;
  for (i = tl - 22; i >= 0; i--) if (tail.getUint32(i, true) === 0x06054b50){ e = i; break; }
  if (e < 0) throw new Error("not a zip");
  var n = tail.getUint16(e + 10, true), cdSize = tail.getUint32(e + 12, true), cdOff = tail.getUint32(e + 16, true);
  if ((n === 0xFFFF || cdSize === 0xFFFFFFFF || cdOff === 0xFFFFFFFF) && e >= 20 && tail.getUint32(e - 20, true) === 0x07064b50){
    var z = new DataView(await blob.slice(u64(tail, e - 12), u64(tail, e - 12) + 56).arrayBuffer());
    if (z.getUint32(0, true) === 0x06064b50){ n = u64(z, 32); cdSize = u64(z, 40); cdOff = u64(z, 48); }
  }
  var cd = new DataView(await blob.slice(cdOff, cdOff + cdSize).arrayBuffer()), u8 = new Uint8Array(cd.buffer), td = new TextDecoder(), out = [], p = 0;
  for (var k = 0; k < n && p + 46 <= cd.byteLength; k++){
    if (cd.getUint32(p, true) !== 0x02014b50) break;
    var flags = cd.getUint16(p + 8, true), method = cd.getUint16(p + 10, true);
    var csize = cd.getUint32(p + 20, true), usize = cd.getUint32(p + 24, true);
    var nl = cd.getUint16(p + 28, true), xl = cd.getUint16(p + 30, true), cl = cd.getUint16(p + 32, true);
    var lho = cd.getUint32(p + 42, true);
    var name = td.decode(u8.subarray(p + 46, p + 46 + nl));
    var x = p + 46 + nl, xe = x + xl;
    while (x + 4 <= xe){
      var id = cd.getUint16(x, true), sz = cd.getUint16(x + 2, true), q = x + 4;
      if (id === 1){
        if (usize === 0xFFFFFFFF){ usize = u64(cd, q); q += 8; }
        if (csize === 0xFFFFFFFF){ csize = u64(cd, q); q += 8; }
        if (lho === 0xFFFFFFFF){ lho = u64(cd, q); q += 8; }
      }
      x += 4 + sz;
    }
    p += 46 + nl + xl + cl;
    if (name.endsWith("/") || (flags & 1)) continue;
    out.push({name: name, method: method, csize: csize, usize: usize, lho: lho});
  }
  return out;
}
async function zipRead(blob, ent){
  var h = new DataView(await blob.slice(ent.lho, ent.lho + 30).arrayBuffer());
  var ds = ent.lho + 30 + h.getUint16(26, true) + h.getUint16(28, true);
  var raw = new Uint8Array(await blob.slice(ds, ds + ent.csize).arrayBuffer());
  if (ent.method === 0) return raw;
  if (ent.method === 8) return inflateRaw(raw);
  throw new Error("zip method " + ent.method);
}
async function zipTexts(blob, want){
  var es = (await zipEntries(blob)).filter(function(e){ return want(e.name); }), out = [], td = new TextDecoder();
  for (var i = 0; i < es.length; i++) out.push({name: es[i].name, text: td.decode(await zipRead(blob, es[i]))});
  return out;
}
function num(s){ return parseInt(s.replace(/\D+/g, ""), 10) || 0; }
/* blob -> parts {loc, text} for one file kind (not pdf, not zip).
   With sink, each part is given to sink as soon as it is read (a huge text file is never held in memory). */
async function readParts(blob, kind, sink){
  var f, out = [];
  if (!sink) sink = function(p){ out.push(p); };
  switch (kind){
    case "text": case "code": {
      var SL = 16 << 20, carry = "", first = true, dec = null;
      for (var at = 0; at < blob.size; at += SL){
        var u8 = new Uint8Array(await blob.slice(at, at + SL).arrayBuffer()), t;
        if (first){
          first = false;
          if (u8[0] === 0xFF && u8[1] === 0xFE) dec = new TextDecoder("utf-16le");
          else if (u8[0] === 0xFE && u8[1] === 0xFF) dec = new TextDecoder("utf-16be");
          else if (u8.subarray(0, 4096).indexOf(0) >= 0) return out;
          else if (blob.size <= SL){ t = decodeText(u8); if (t) sink({loc: 0, text: t}); return out; }
          else dec = new TextDecoder("utf-8");
        }
        t = carry + dec.decode(u8, {stream: at + SL < blob.size});
        var cut = at + SL < blob.size ? Math.max(t.lastIndexOf("\n"), t.lastIndexOf(" ")) : t.length;
        if (cut <= 0) cut = t.length;
        sink({loc: 0, text: t.slice(0, cut)}); carry = t.slice(cut);
      }
      if (carry) sink({loc: 0, text: carry});
      return out;
    }
    case "docx":
      f = await zipTexts(blob, function(n){ return /^word\/(document|footnotes|endnotes)\.xml$/.test(n); });
      f.forEach(function(x){ sink({loc: 0, text: xmlText(x.text, "w:p")}); });
      return out;
    case "pptx":
      f = (await zipTexts(blob, function(n){ return /^ppt\/slides\/slide\d+\.xml$/.test(n); })).sort(function(a, b){ return num(a.name) - num(b.name); });
      f.forEach(function(x){ sink({loc: num(x.name), text: xmlText(x.text, "a:p")}); });
      return out;
    case "doc": sink({loc: 0, text: docText(await cfbOpen(blob))}); return out;
    case "xls": xlsParts(await cfbOpen(blob)).forEach(sink); return out;
    case "ppt": pptParts(await cfbOpen(blob)).forEach(sink); return out;
    case "xlsx": {
      /* shared strings, inline strings and the numbers in each sheet */
      f = await zipTexts(blob, function(n){ return n === "xl/sharedStrings.xml" || /^xl\/worksheets\/sheet\d+\.xml$/.test(n); });
      f.forEach(function(x){
        if (x.name === "xl/sharedStrings.xml") sink({loc: 0, text: xmlText(x.text, "si")});
        else {
          var cells = [], m, re = /<c\b([^>]*)>([\s\S]*?)<\/c>/g;
          while ((m = re.exec(x.text)) !== null){
            if (/t="s"/.test(m[1])) continue;                       /* shared string: already in sharedStrings */
            var v = /<v>([^<]*)<\/v>/.exec(m[2]) || /<t[^>]*>([^<]*)<\/t>/.exec(m[2]);
            if (v) cells.push(decodeEnt(v[1]));
          }
          if (cells.length) sink({loc: num(x.name), text: cells.join(" ")});
        }
      });
      return out;
    }
  }
  return out;
}

/* ---- OLE compound files: old .doc, .xls, .ppt and Outlook .msg ---- */
async function cfbOpen(blob){
  var buf = await blob.arrayBuffer(), dv = new DataView(buf), u8 = new Uint8Array(buf);
  if (dv.getUint32(0, true) !== 0xE011CFD0 || dv.getUint32(4, true) !== 0xE11AB1A1) throw new Error("not an OLE file");
  var ss = 1 << dv.getUint16(30, true), mss = 1 << dv.getUint16(32, true);
  var dirStart = dv.getUint32(48, true), cutoff = dv.getUint32(56, true), miniStart = dv.getUint32(60, true);
  var difatStart = dv.getUint32(68, true), nDifat = dv.getUint32(72, true), END = 0xFFFFFFFE;
  var nSec = Math.floor((buf.byteLength - ss) / ss) + 1, fatSecs = [], i, s;
  for (i = 0; i < 109; i++){ s = dv.getUint32(76 + i * 4, true); if (s < nSec) fatSecs.push(s); }
  for (var d = difatStart, k = 0; d < nSec && k < nDifat; k++){
    var o = (d + 1) * ss, per = ss / 4 - 1;
    for (i = 0; i < per; i++){ s = dv.getUint32(o + i * 4, true); if (s < nSec) fatSecs.push(s); }
    d = dv.getUint32(o + per * 4, true);
  }
  var fat = new Uint32Array(fatSecs.length * ss / 4);
  fatSecs.forEach(function(fs, j){ fat.set(new Uint32Array(buf.slice((fs + 1) * ss, (fs + 2) * ss)), j * ss / 4); });
  function chain(start, table, size, base, secSize){
    var out = [], n = 0, x = start, guard = 0;
    while (x !== END && x < table.length && guard++ < 10000000){ out.push(x); x = table[x]; }
    var res = new Uint8Array(size !== undefined ? size : out.length * secSize), pos = 0;
    for (i = 0; i < out.length && pos < res.length; i++){
      var off = base(out[i]), take = Math.min(secSize, res.length - pos);
      res.set((off === null ? u8 : base.src).subarray(off === null ? 0 : off, (off === null ? 0 : off) + take), pos); pos += take;
    }
    return res;
  }
  function big(x){ return (x + 1) * ss; } big.src = u8;
  var dir = chain(dirStart, fat, undefined, big, ss), ddv = new DataView(dir.buffer), td = new TextDecoder("utf-16le"), E2 = [];
  for (var e = 0; e * 128 + 128 <= dir.length; e++){
    var p = e * 128, nl = ddv.getUint16(p + 64, true);
    E2.push({name: td.decode(dir.subarray(p, p + Math.max(0, nl - 2))), type: dir[p + 66], left: ddv.getUint32(p + 68, true),
             right: ddv.getUint32(p + 72, true), child: ddv.getUint32(p + 76, true), start: ddv.getUint32(p + 116, true), size: ddv.getUint32(p + 120, true)});
  }
  var root = E2[0];
  var mini = chain(root.start, fat, root.size, big, ss);
  var minifat = new Uint32Array(chain(miniStart, fat, undefined, big, ss).slice().buffer);
  function small(x){ return x * mss; } small.src = mini;
  /* walk the directory tree: path names like "__attach_version1.0_#00000000/__substg1.0_3707001F" */
  var byPath = new Map();
  function walk(idx, prefix, depth){
    if (idx >= E2.length || depth > 64) return;
    var ent = E2[idx]; if (!ent || ent.seen) return; ent.seen = true;
    walk(ent.left, prefix, depth + 1); walk(ent.right, prefix, depth + 1);
    var path = prefix + ent.name;
    byPath.set(path, ent);
    if (ent.type === 1) walk(ent.child, path + "/", depth + 1);
  }
  walk(root.child, "", 0);
  return {
    paths: function(){ return Array.from(byPath.keys()); },
    has: function(p){ return byPath.has(p); },
    read: function(p){
      var ent = byPath.get(p); if (!ent || ent.type !== 2) return null;
      return ent.size < cutoff ? chain(ent.start, minifat, ent.size, small, mss) : chain(ent.start, fat, ent.size, big, ss);
    }
  };
}
var LATIN1 = new TextDecoder("windows-1252"), UTF16 = new TextDecoder("utf-16le");
function cleanOld(t){ return t.replace(/\r/g, "\n").replace(/[\x07\x0b\x0c]/g, "\t").replace(/[\x00-\x08\x0e-\x1f]/g, " "); }
/* .doc (Word 97-2003): text pieces from the piece table */
function docText(cf){
  var wd = cf.read("WordDocument"); if (!wd) return "";
  var w = new DataView(wd.buffer, wd.byteOffset, wd.byteLength);
  var tbl = cf.read((w.getUint16(0x0A, true) & 0x0200) ? "1Table" : "0Table");
  var fcClx = w.getUint32(0x01A2, true), lcbClx = w.getUint32(0x01A6, true), out = [];
  if (tbl && lcbClx && fcClx + lcbClx <= tbl.length){
    var t = new DataView(tbl.buffer, tbl.byteOffset, tbl.byteLength), p = fcClx, end = fcClx + lcbClx;
    while (p < end && tbl[p] === 1) p += 3 + t.getInt16(p + 1, true);
    if (tbl[p] === 2){
      var lcb = t.getUint32(p + 1, true), q = p + 5, n = (lcb - 4) / 12;
      for (var i = 0; i < n; i++){
        var cp0 = t.getUint32(q + i * 4, true), cp1 = t.getUint32(q + (i + 1) * 4, true), fc = t.getUint32(q + (n + 1) * 4 + i * 8 + 2, true);
        var len = cp1 - cp0; if (len <= 0) continue;
        if (fc & 0x40000000){ var o = (fc & 0x3FFFFFFF) / 2; out.push(LATIN1.decode(wd.subarray(o, o + len))); }
        else out.push(UTF16.decode(wd.subarray(fc, fc + len * 2)));
      }
    }
  }
  /* field codes: drop the instruction part between 0x13 and 0x14 */
  return cleanOld(out.join("").replace(/\x13[^\x13\x14\x15]*\x14/g, "").replace(/[\x13\x14\x15]/g, ""));
}
/* .xls (Excel 97-2003, BIFF8): shared strings, text cells and sheet names */
function xlsParts(cf){
  var wb = cf.read("Workbook") || cf.read("Book"); if (!wb) return [];
  var dv = new DataView(wb.buffer, wb.byteOffset, wb.byteLength), p = 0, sst = [], sheet = 0, cells = {}, names = [];
  function str8(u, o, cch, high){ return high ? UTF16.decode(u.subarray(o, o + cch * 2)) : LATIN1.decode(u.subarray(o, o + cch)); }
  while (p + 4 <= wb.length){
    var type = dv.getUint16(p, true), len = dv.getUint16(p + 2, true), d = p + 4;
    if (type === 0x002F) return [];                                 /* encrypted */
    if (type === 0x0809){ var bt = dv.getUint16(d + 2, true); if (bt === 0x10) sheet++; }
    else if (type === 0x0085 && len > 8){ var cch = wb[d + 6]; names.push(str8(wb, d + 8, cch, wb[d + 7] & 1)); }
    else if (type === 0x00FC){
      /* SST and its CONTINUE records; strings can cross a CONTINUE, where a new flag byte starts */
      var segs = [wb.subarray(d + 8, d + len)], r = p + 4 + len;
      while (r + 4 <= wb.length && dv.getUint16(r, true) === 0x003C){ var l2 = dv.getUint16(r + 2, true); segs.push(wb.subarray(r + 4, r + 4 + l2)); r += 4 + l2; }
      var si = 0, sp = 0, total = dv.getUint32(d + 4, true);
      var byte = function(){ while (si < segs.length && sp >= segs[si].length){ si++; sp = 0; } if (si >= segs.length) throw 0; return segs[si][sp++]; };
      var skip = function(n){ while (n-- > 0) byte(); };
      try {
        for (var k = 0; k < total; k++){
          var c = byte() | (byte() << 8), fl = byte(), rt = 0, ext = 0, high = fl & 1, txt = "";
          if (fl & 8) rt = byte() | (byte() << 8);
          if (fl & 4) ext = byte() | (byte() << 8) | (byte() << 16) | (byte() << 24);
          while (c > 0){
            if (sp >= segs[si].length){ si++; sp = 0; if (si >= segs.length) throw 0; high = segs[si][sp++] & 1; }
            var seg = segs[si], n = Math.min(c, high ? (seg.length - sp) >> 1 : seg.length - sp);
            if (n <= 0){ sp = seg.length; continue; }
            txt += str8(seg, sp, n, high); sp += high ? n * 2 : n; c -= n;
          }
          skip(rt * 4 + ext);
          sst.push(txt);
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    }
    else if ((type === 0x0204 || type === 0x0207) && len > 3){
      var o2 = type === 0x0204 ? d + 6 : d, cc = dv.getUint16(o2, true);
      (cells[sheet] = cells[sheet] || []).push(str8(wb, o2 + 3, cc, wb[o2 + 2] & 1));
    }
    p += 4 + len;
  }
  var out = [];
  if (sst.length) out.push({loc: 0, text: sst.join("\n")});
  if (names.length) out.push({loc: 0, text: names.join("\n")});
  Object.keys(cells).forEach(function(s){ out.push({loc: +s, text: cells[s].join("\n")}); });
  return out;
}
/* .ppt (PowerPoint 97-2003): text atoms, counted by slide; master and notes text is skipped */
function pptParts(cf){
  var s = cf.read("PowerPoint Document"); if (!s) return [];
  var dv = new DataView(s.buffer, s.byteOffset, s.byteLength), p = 0, stack = [], slides = 0, listed = 0, texts = {};
  function inside(t){ for (var i = stack.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) if (stack[i].type === t) return stack[i]; return null; }
  while (p + 8 <= s.length){
    while (stack.length && p >= stack[stack.length - 1].end) stack.pop();
    var vi = dv.getUint16(p, true), type = dv.getUint16(p + 2, true), len = dv.getUint32(p + 4, true);
    if ((vi & 0xF) === 0xF){
      var c = {type: type, end: p + 8 + len, inst: vi >> 4};
      if (type === 0x03EE) c.slide = ++slides;                         /* Slide */
      stack.push(c); p += 8; continue;
    }
    var list = inside(0x0FF0);                                          /* SlideListWithText */
    if (type === 0x03F3 && list && list.inst === 0) listed++;           /* one per slide */
    var t = null;
    if (type === 0x0FA0) t = UTF16.decode(s.subarray(p + 8, p + 8 + len));
    else if (type === 0x0FA8) t = LATIN1.decode(s.subarray(p + 8, p + 8 + len));
    if (t && !inside(0x03F8) && !inside(0x03F0) && !(list && list.inst !== 0)){   /* not master, not notes */
      var sl = inside(0x03EE), loc = list ? listed : sl ? sl.slide : 0;
      (texts[loc] = texts[loc] || []).push(cleanOld(t));
    }
    p += 8 + len;
  }
  return Object.keys(texts).map(function(k){ return {loc: +k, text: texts[k].join("\n")}; });
}
/* .msg (Outlook): sender, recipients, subject, body; attachments come back as their own files */
function msgProp(cf, pre, id){
  var u = cf.read(pre + "__substg1.0_" + id + "001F"); if (u) return UTF16.decode(u).replace(/\0+$/, "");
  var a = cf.read(pre + "__substg1.0_" + id + "001E"); if (a) return LATIN1.decode(a).replace(/\0+$/, "");
  return "";
}
function msgText(cf){
  var body = msgProp(cf, "", "1000");
  if (!body.trim()){ var h = cf.read("__substg1.0_10130102"); if (h) body = htmlToText(new TextDecoder().decode(h)); }
  return "From: " + msgProp(cf, "", "0C1A") + "\nTo: " + msgProp(cf, "", "0E04") + "\nCc: " + msgProp(cf, "", "0E03") +
         "\nSubject: " + msgProp(cf, "", "0037") + "\n\n" + body;
}
function msgAttachments(cf){
  var seen = new Set(), out = [];
  cf.paths().forEach(function(p){
    var m = /^(__attach_version1\.0_#[0-9A-Fa-f]{8})\//.exec(p);
    if (!m || seen.has(m[1])) return; seen.add(m[1]);
    var pre = m[1] + "/", name = msgProp(cf, pre, "3707") || msgProp(cf, pre, "3704") || m[1];
    var data = cf.read(pre + "__substg1.0_37010102");
    if (data) out.push({name: name, bytes: data});
  });
  return out;
}
function htmlToText(s){
  s = s.replace(/<(script|style)\b[\s\S]*?<\/\1\s*>/gi, " ").replace(/<\/(p|div|li|tr|h[1-6])\s*>|<br\s*\/?>/gi, "\n");
  return decodeEnt(s.replace(/<[^>]*>/g, " ")).replace(/[ \t]+/g, " ");
}

/* passages of about 80 words, 20 words overlap */
function chunks(text){
  var out = [], re = /\S+/g, starts = [], ends = [], m;
  while ((m = re.exec(text)) !== null){ starts.push(m.index); ends.push(m.index + m[0].length); }
  for (var i = 0; i < starts.length; i += 60){
    var j = Math.min(starts.length, i + 80) - 1, s = text.slice(starts[i], ends[j]);
    out.push(s.length > 1500 ? s.slice(0, 1500) : s);
    if (j === starts.length - 1) break;
  }
  return out;
}
function nameText(path){
  var parts = path.split("/"), file = parts.pop().replace(/\.[^.]+$/, "");
  function human(s){ return s.replace(/([a-z])([A-Z])/g, "$1 $2").replace(/[_\-.+!]+/g, " "); }
  return human(file) + " (" + parts.slice(-3).map(human).join(" / ") + ")";
}
/* share of letters among non-space characters: number dumps score low */
function wordiness(s){
  var letters = 0, other = 0, n = Math.min(s.length, 4000);
  for (var i = 0; i < n; i++){
    var c = s.charCodeAt(i);
    if (c <= 32) continue;
    if ((c >= 65 && c <= 90) || (c >= 97 && c <= 122) || c >= 0xC0) letters++; else other++;
  }
  return letters + other ? letters / (letters + other) : 0;
}
/* passages kept from a part: almost-only-number passages are not stored */
function collect(acc, part){
  var cs = chunks(part.text);
  for (var c = 0; c < cs.length; c++){
    var s = cs[c];
    if (wordiness(s) < 0.3){
      /* mostly numbers: keep only the lines that have words */
      s = s.split("\n").filter(function(l){ return wordiness(l) >= 0.5; }).join("\n");
      if (s.split(/\s+/).length < 3) continue;
    }
    acc.locs.push(part.loc); acc.texts.push(s);
  }
}
async function embedFile(blob, kind, path){
  var acc = {locs: [-1], texts: [path]};
  await readParts(blob, kind, function(p){ collect(acc, p); });
  return vectorize(acc.locs, acc.texts, path);
}
/* parts -> {locs, texts, vecs} with int8 unit vectors (x127) */
function embedParts(parts, path){
  var acc = {locs: [-1], texts: [path]};
  for (var p = 0; p < parts.length; p++) collect(acc, parts[p]);
  return vectorize(acc.locs, acc.texts, path);
}
function vectorize(locs, texts, path){
  var inputs = texts.slice(); inputs[0] = nameText(path);
  var n = texts.length, vecs = new Int8Array(n * DIM), keep = new Uint8Array(n), asc = [], ascIdx = [], i, k;
  for (i = 0; i < n; i++){
    if (X && !RE_NONASCII.test(inputs[i])){ asc.push(inputs[i]); ascIdx.push(i); continue; }
    var v = embed(inputs[i]);
    if (v){ keep[i] = 1; for (k = 0; k < DIM; k++) vecs[i * DIM + k] = Math.round(v[k] * 127); }
  }
  for (var b = 0; b < asc.length; b += 4096){
    var r = wasmBatch(asc.slice(b, b + 4096));
    for (var j = 0; j < r.ok.length; j++){
      if (!r.ok[j]) continue;
      var d = ascIdx[b + j]; keep[d] = 1;
      vecs.set(r.vecs.subarray(j * DIM, j * DIM + DIM), d * DIM);
    }
  }
  /* drop passages with no known words */
  var m = 0, L = [], T = [];
  for (i = 0; i < n; i++) if (keep[i]){ if (m !== i) vecs.copyWithin(m * DIM, i * DIM, i * DIM + DIM); L.push(locs[i]); T.push(texts[i]); m++; }
  var sigs = new Uint8Array(m * SIG);
  for (i = 0; i < m; i++) sigOf(T[i], sigs, i * SIG);
  return {locs: Int32Array.from(L), texts: T, vecs: vecs.slice(0, m * DIM), sigs: sigs};
}
var SUB = {txt: 1, md: 1, markdown: 1};
/* a zip or an Outlook message: each supported file inside becomes its own result; PDFs go back to the page for PDF.js */
async function readBox(blob, boxPath, kind){
  var items = [], main = null, subs = [], pdfs = [];
  if (kind === "msg"){
    var cf = await cfbOpen(blob);
    main = embedParts([{loc: 0, text: msgText(cf)}], boxPath);
    msgAttachments(cf).forEach(function(a){ items.push({name: a.name, bytes: a.bytes}); });
  } else {
    var es = await zipEntries(blob);
    for (var i = 0; i < es.length; i++){
      if (!kindOf(es[i].name.split("/").pop())) continue;
      try { items.push({name: es[i].name, bytes: await zipRead(blob, es[i])}); } catch (err) {}
    }
  }
  for (var j = 0; j < items.length; j++){
    var it = items[j], k = kindOf(it.name.split("/").pop());
    if (!k || k === "zip" || k === "msg") continue;
    var path = boxPath + "!/" + it.name;
    if (k === "pdf"){ pdfs.push({path: path, bytes: it.bytes}); continue; }
    try { var r = await embedFile(new Blob([it.bytes]), k, path); r.path = path; r.kind = k; subs.push(r); } catch (err) {}
  }
  return {main: main, subs: subs, pdfs: pdfs};
}
/* one file inside a zip or a message, for "Open" */
async function boxItem(blob, kind, name){
  if (kind === "msg"){ var a = msgAttachments(await cfbOpen(blob)).find(function(x){ return x.name === name; }); return a ? a.bytes : null; }
  var e = (await zipEntries(blob)).find(function(x){ return x.name === name; });
  return e ? zipRead(blob, e) : null;
}

/* word fingerprint: each word sets 3 of 512 bits (64 bytes a passage) */
var SIG = 64, RE_W = /[\p{L}\p{N}]+/gu;
function fnv(w){ var h = 2166136261; for (var i = 0; i < w.length; i++){ h ^= w.charCodeAt(i); h = Math.imul(h, 16777619); } return h >>> 0; }
function wordBits(w){ var h = fnv(w), out = []; for (var j = 0; j < 3; j++){ var b = (h >>> (9 * j)) & 511; out.push(b >> 3, 1 << (b & 7)); } return out; }
function words(text){
  var out = [], m, t = text.toLowerCase(); RE_W.lastIndex = 0;
  while ((m = RE_W.exec(t)) !== null) if (m[0].length > 1 || (m[0] >= "0" && m[0] <= "9")) out.push(m[0]);
  return out;
}
function sigOf(text, out, off){
  var ws = words(text);
  for (var i = 0; i < ws.length; i++){ var b = wordBits(ws[i]); out[off + b[0]] |= b[1]; out[off + b[2]] |= b[3]; out[off + b[4]] |= b[5]; }
}
var api = {sigOf: sigOf, words: words, wordBits: wordBits, SIG: SIG, initModel: initModel, tokenize: tokenize, embed: embed, kindOf: kindOf, skipDir: skipDir, readParts: readParts,
           embedParts: embedParts, embedFile: embedFile, readBox: readBox, boxItem: boxItem, zipEntries: zipEntries, zipRead: zipRead, chunks: chunks, extOf: extOf,
           get wasm(){ return !!X; }, get DIM(){ return DIM; }};

if (typeof WorkerGlobalScope !== "undefined" && self instanceof WorkerGlobalScope){
  self.onmessage = async function(e){
    var m = e.data;
    if (m.t === "init"){ var ok = await initModel(m.model); self.postMessage({t: "ready", wasm: ok}); return; }
    var t0 = performance.now(), r, transfer = [];
    try {
      if (m.t === "box"){
        r = await readBox(m.file, m.path, m.kind);
        if (r.main) transfer.push(r.main.locs.buffer, r.main.vecs.buffer, r.main.sigs.buffer);
        r.subs.forEach(function(s){ transfer.push(s.locs.buffer, s.vecs.buffer, s.sigs.buffer); });
        r.pdfs.forEach(function(p){ transfer.push(p.bytes.buffer); });
      } else {
        r = m.t === "file" ? await embedFile(m.file, m.kind, m.path) : embedParts(m.parts, m.path);
        transfer.push(r.locs.buffer, r.vecs.buffer, r.sigs.buffer);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      r = m.t === "box" ? {main: null, subs: [], pdfs: []} : embedParts([], m.path);
      if (r.locs) transfer = [r.locs.buffer, r.vecs.buffer, r.sigs.buffer];
      r.err = String(err && err.message || err);
    }
    r.t = "done"; r.id = m.id; r.ms = performance.now() - t0;
    self.postMessage(r, transfer);
  };
}
return api;
})();
</script>

<script>
"use strict";
const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);
const fmt = n => n.toLocaleString();
function toast(t){ const e = $("toast"); e.textContent = t; e.classList.add("on"); clearTimeout(toast.t); toast.t = setTimeout(() => e.classList.remove("on"), 1800); }
function esc(s){ return s.replace(/[&<>"]/g, c => ({"&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;",'"':"&quot;"}[c])); }
/* yield without setTimeout: background tabs throttle timers, not message ports */
const tick = () => new Promise(r => { const c = new MessageChannel(); c.port1.onmessage = () => r(); c.port2.postMessage(0); });
function fmtTime(s){ s = Math.max(0, Math.round(s)); return s < 60 ? s + " s" : s < 3600 ? Math.floor(s / 60) + " min " + (s % 60) + " s" : Math.floor(s / 3600) + " h " + Math.floor(s % 3600 / 60) + " min"; }
function b64bytes(id){
  const s = $(id).textContent.replace(/\s+/g, "");
  if (Uint8Array.fromBase64) return Uint8Array.fromBase64(s);
  const bin = atob(s), out = new Uint8Array(bin.length);
  for (let i = 0; i < bin.length; i++) out[i] = bin.charCodeAt(i);
  return out;
}
async function inflate(bytes){
  const st = new Blob([bytes]).stream().pipeThrough(new DecompressionStream("deflate-raw"));
  return new Uint8Array(await new Response(st).arrayBuffer());
}

/* ---------- model ---------- */
let MODEL = null, E = null, DIM = 256;
async function loadModel(){
  const vocab = new TextDecoder().decode(await inflate(b64bytes("b-vocab"))).split("\n");
  const mb = await inflate(b64bytes("b-model")), dv = new DataView(mb.buffer);
  const rows = dv.getUint32(0, true), dim = dv.getUint32(4, true);
  const sc = new Float32Array(mb.buffer.slice(8, 8 + rows * 4)), p = new Uint8Array(mb.buffer, 8 + rows * 4), q = new Int8Array(rows * dim);
  for (let i = 0, j = 0; i < q.length; i += 4, j += 3){
    const w = p[j] | (p[j + 1] << 8) | (p[j + 2] << 16);
    q[i] = (w & 63) - 31; q[i + 1] = ((w >> 6) & 63) - 31; q[i + 2] = ((w >> 12) & 63) - 31; q[i + 3] = ((w >> 18) & 63) - 31;
  }
  let wasm = null;
  try { wasm = await WebAssembly.compile(await inflate(b64bytes("b-wasm"))); } catch (e) { console.warn("no WebAssembly", e); }
  MODEL = {vocab, q, sc, rows, dim, wasm};
  (0, eval)($("engine").textContent);
  E = globalThis.ENGINE; await E.initModel(MODEL); DIM = dim;
}

/* ---------- engine workers ---------- */
let POOL = null;
async function getPool(){
  if (POOL) return POOL;
  const n = Math.max(1, Math.min(16, (navigator.hardwareConcurrency || 4) - 1));
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([$("engine").textContent], {type: "text/javascript"}));
  const starts = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++){
    starts.push((async () => {
      try {
        const w = new Worker(url);
        const ok = await new Promise(res => {
          const t = setTimeout(() => res(false), 15000);
          w.onmessage = e => { if (e.data.t === "ready"){ clearTimeout(t); res(true); } };
          w.onerror = () => { clearTimeout(t); res(false); };
          w.postMessage({t: "init", model: MODEL});
        });
        if (ok){ w.onmessage = onWorkerMessage; return w; }
        w.terminate();
      } catch (e) {}
      return null;
    })());
  }
  const ws = (await Promise.all(starts)).filter(Boolean);
  POOL = {workers: ws, size: ws.length};
  return POOL;
}
const WAIT = new Map(); let JOB = 0;
function onWorkerMessage(e){ const r = WAIT.get(e.data.id); if (r){ WAIT.delete(e.data.id); r(e.data); } }
function runJob(w, msg){ return new Promise(res => { const id = ++JOB; msg.id = id; WAIT.set(id, res); w.postMessage(msg); }); }
async function runLocal(msg){
  const t0 = performance.now();
  let r;
  try {
    if (msg.t === "box") r = await E.readBox(msg.file, msg.path, msg.kind);
    else r = msg.t === "file" ? await E.embedFile(msg.file, msg.kind, msg.path) : E.embedParts(msg.parts, msg.path);
  } catch (e) { r = msg.t === "box" ? {main: null, subs: [], pdfs: []} : E.embedParts([], msg.path); r.err = String(e.message || e); }
  r.ms = performance.now() - t0;
  return r;
}

/* ---------- PDF.js ---------- */
let PDF = null;
async function getPdf(){
  if (PDF) return PDF;
  const libUrl = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([await inflate(b64bytes("b-pdf"))], {type: "text/javascript"}));
  const wrkUrl = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([await inflate(b64bytes("b-pdfw"))], {type: "text/javascript"}));
  const lib = await import(libUrl);
  lib.GlobalWorkerOptions.workerSrc = wrkUrl;
  /* the worker is a classic script (see build.py): module workers do not load from file:// pages */
  const workers = [], n = Math.max(1, Math.min(8, Math.floor((navigator.hardwareConcurrency || 4) / 2)));
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++){ try { workers.push(new lib.PDFWorker({port: new Worker(wrkUrl)})); } catch (e) { break; } }
  if (!workers.length){
    await new Promise((res, rej) => { const s = document.createElement("script"); s.src = wrkUrl; s.onload = res; s.onerror = rej; document.head.appendChild(s); });
    workers.push(null);
  }
  PDF = {lib, free: workers.slice(), waiters: [], n: workers.length};
  return PDF;
}
async function pdfParts(bytes){
  const P = await getPdf();
  while (!P.free.length) await new Promise(r => P.waiters.push(r));
  const pw = P.free.pop();
  const task = P.lib.getDocument({data: bytes, isEvalSupported: false, verbosity: 0, ...(pw ? {worker: pw} : {})});
  const parts = [];
  try {
    const doc = await task.promise;
    /* ask for all pages at once: the PDF worker runs them back to back */
    const pages = await Promise.all(Array.from({length: doc.numPages}, (_, i) => doc.getPage(i + 1).then(async pg => {
      if (STOP) return null;
      const tc = await pg.getTextContent();
      pg.cleanup();
      return {loc: i + 1, text: tc.items.map(it => (it.str || "") + (it.hasEOL ? "\n" : " ")).join("")};
    })));
    for (const p of pages) if (p) parts.push(p);
  } finally {
    try { await task.destroy(); } catch (e) {}
    P.free.push(pw); const w = P.waiters.shift(); if (w) w();
  }
  return parts;
}

/* ---------- index ---------- */
/* files: [{p, s, m, k, r}]  p is the path in the folder; a file in a zip is "a.zip!/inner/path"
   passages are columns: cf file id, cl loc (-1 name, 0 body, n page/slide/sheet), ct text, vec int8 */
let IX = emptyIndex(), ROOTS = [], STOP = false, BUSY = false, FULL = false;
function emptyIndex(){ return {files: [], cf: [], cl: [], ct: [], vec: new Int8Array(0), sig: new Uint8Array(0), n: 0, cap: 0, at: 0, mem: 0}; }
const SIG = 64;
const fmtMB = b => fmt(Math.round(b / 1e6)) + " MB";
function grow(ix, need){
  if (ix.n + need <= ix.cap) return;
  let cap = Math.max(4096, ix.cap * 2); while (cap < ix.n + need) cap *= 2;
  const nv = new Int8Array(cap * DIM); nv.set(ix.vec.subarray(0, ix.n * DIM)); ix.vec = nv;
  const ns = new Uint8Array(cap * SIG); ns.set(ix.sig.subarray(0, ix.n * SIG)); ix.sig = ns; ix.cap = cap;
}
function addPassages(ix, fid, locs, texts, vecs, sigs){
  const m = locs.length;
  grow(ix, m);
  ix.vec.set(vecs.subarray(0, m * DIM), ix.n * DIM);
  if (sigs) ix.sig.set(sigs.subarray(0, m * SIG), ix.n * SIG);
  else for (let i = 0; i < m; i++) E.sigOf(texts[i], ix.sig, (ix.n + i) * SIG);
  let chars = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < m; i++){ ix.cf.push(fid); ix.cl.push(locs[i]); ix.ct.push(texts[i]); chars += texts[i].length; }
  ix.n += m;
  ix.mem += m * (DIM + 40) + chars * 2;     /* vector + array slots + text (2 bytes a character) */
}
const RE_TERM = /[\p{L}\p{N}]+(?:[\-_.\/#:][\p{L}\p{N}]+)*/gu;
function termsOf(s){
  const out = new Set();
  for (const m of s.toLowerCase().matchAll(RE_TERM)){ const t = m[0]; if (t.length > 1 || /\d/.test(t)) out.add(t); }
  return [...out];
}

/* ---------- storage: IndexedDB, in batches ---------- */
function idb(){
  return new Promise((res, rej) => {
    let r; try { r = indexedDB.open("babydig", 1); } catch (e) { return rej(e); }
    r.onupgradeneeded = () => { const db = r.result; for (const s of ["kv", "b"]) if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains(s)) db.createObjectStore(s); };
    r.onsuccess = () => res(r.result); r.onerror = () => rej(r.error);
  });
}
async function tx(store, mode, fn){
  const db = await idb();
  try { return await new Promise((res, rej) => { const t = db.transaction(store, mode); const out = fn(t.objectStore(store)); t.oncomplete = () => res(out && out.result); t.onerror = () => rej(t.error); t.onabort = () => rej(t.error); }); }
  finally { db.close(); }
}
const BATCH = 20000;
async function saveBatches(ix, gen, from){
  for (let b = Math.floor(from / BATCH); b * BATCH < ix.n; b++){
    const s = b * BATCH, e = Math.min(ix.n, s + BATCH);
    const rec = {cf: Uint32Array.from(ix.cf.slice(s, e)), cl: Int32Array.from(ix.cl.slice(s, e)), ct: ix.ct.slice(s, e), vec: ix.vec.slice(s * DIM, e * DIM), sig: ix.sig.slice(s * SIG, e * SIG)};
    await tx("b", "readwrite", st => st.put(rec, gen + ":" + b));
  }
  return Math.floor(ix.n / BATCH) * BATCH;
}
const rootsRec = () => ROOTS.map(r => ({name: r.name, handle: r.handle || null, base: r.base || ""}));
async function saveMeta(ix, gen){
  await tx("kv", "readwrite", st => { st.put({gen, files: ix.files, n: ix.n, at: ix.at}, "meta"); st.put(rootsRec(), "roots"); });
  const keys = await tx("b", "readonly", st => st.getAllKeys());
  const old = (keys || []).filter(k => !String(k).startsWith(gen + ":") || parseInt(String(k).split(":")[1]) * BATCH >= Math.max(ix.n, 1));
  if (old.length) await tx("b", "readwrite", st => { for (const k of old) st.delete(k); });
}
async function saveRoots(){ try { await tx("kv", "readwrite", st => st.put(rootsRec(), "roots")); } catch (e) {} }
async function saveAll(ix){
  try { const gen = Date.now().toString(36); await saveBatches(ix, gen, 0); await saveMeta(ix, gen); return true; }
  catch (e) { console.warn("save failed", e); return false; }
}
async function loadAll(){
  const roots = await tx("kv", "readonly", st => st.get("roots"));
  if (roots) ROOTS = roots.map(r => ({name: r.name, handle: r.handle || null, base: r.base || ""}));
  const meta = await tx("kv", "readonly", st => st.get("meta"));
  if (!meta || !meta.n) return;
  const ix = emptyIndex(); ix.files = meta.files; ix.at = meta.at;
  grow(ix, meta.n);
  for (let b = 0; b * BATCH < meta.n; b++){
    const r = await tx("b", "readonly", st => st.get(meta.gen + ":" + b));
    if (!r) break;
    ix.vec.set(r.vec, ix.n * DIM);
    if (r.sig) ix.sig.set(r.sig, ix.n * SIG); else for (let i = 0; i < r.ct.length; i++) E.sigOf(r.ct[i], ix.sig, (ix.n + i) * SIG);
    let chars = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < r.ct.length; i++){ ix.cf.push(r.cf[i]); ix.cl.push(r.cl[i]); ix.ct.push(r.ct[i]); chars += r.ct[i].length; }
    ix.n += r.ct.length; ix.mem += r.ct.length * (DIM + 40) + chars * 2;
  }
  IX = ix;
}

/* ---------- finding files: many folders listed at the same time ---------- */
async function listRoot(ri, out, stats){
  const r = ROOTS[ri];
  if (r.handle){
    const queue = [[r.handle, ""]];
    let active = 0, lastUi = 0;
    await new Promise(done => {
      const pump = () => {
        if (STOP && !active) return done();
        while (!STOP && active < 24 && queue.length){
          const [dir, pre] = queue.pop();
          active++;
          (async () => {
            const gets = [];
            try {
              for await (const [name, h] of dir.entries()){
                if (h.kind === "directory"){ if (!E.skipDir(name)) queue.push([h, pre + name + "/"]); continue; }
                stats.seen++;
                const kind = name.startsWith("~$") ? null : E.kindOf(name);
                if (!kind) continue;                                 /* not opened */
                gets.push(h.getFile().then(file => out.push({ri, path: pre + name, file, kind}), () => {}));
              }
              await Promise.all(gets);
            } catch (e) { console.warn("cannot list", pre, e); }
            active--;
            const now = performance.now();
            if (now - lastUi > 200){ lastUi = now; log("Finding files in " + r.name + ": " + fmt(stats.seen) + " seen, " + fmt(out.length) + " to read"); }
            if (!active && (!queue.length || STOP)) done(); else pump();
          })();
        }
      };
      pump();
    });
  } else if (r.files){
    for (const [p, file] of r.files){
      const segs = p.split("/"), name = segs[segs.length - 1];
      if (segs.slice(0, -1).some(s => E.skipDir(s))) continue;
      stats.seen++;
      const kind = name.startsWith("~$") ? null : E.kindOf(name);
      if (kind) out.push({ri, path: p, file, kind});
    }
  }
}
async function ensurePermission(r){
  if (!r.handle) return !!r.files;
  try {
    if ((await r.handle.queryPermission({mode: "read"})) === "granted") return true;
    return (await r.handle.requestPermission({mode: "read"})) === "granted";
  } catch (e) { return false; }
}

/* ---------- indexing ---------- */
async function runIndex(){
  if (BUSY) return;
  BUSY = true; STOP = false; FULL = false; setBusy(true);
  const t0 = performance.now();
  try {
    for (const r of ROOTS) if (!(await ensurePermission(r))) toast("No access to " + r.name + ". Add it again.");
    const poolP = getPool();                        /* start the workers while files are listed */
    const stats = {seen: 0};
    const work = [];
    for (let ri = 0; ri < ROOTS.length && !STOP; ri++) if (ROOTS[ri].handle || ROOTS[ri].files) await listRoot(ri, work, stats);
    const tList = performance.now() - t0;

    /* unchanged files keep their passages; a zip keeps the files inside it */
    const OLD = IX, keyOf = f => (ROOTS[f.r] ? ROOTS[f.r].name : "") + "\u0000" + f.p;
    const oldBy = new Map(), oldChunks = new Map(), oldInner = new Map();
    OLD.files.forEach((f, i) => {
      oldBy.set(keyOf(f), i);
      const z = f.p.indexOf("!/");
      if (z > 0){ const k = keyOf({r: f.r, p: f.p.slice(0, z)}); let a = oldInner.get(k); if (!a){ a = []; oldInner.set(k, a); } a.push(i); }
    });
    for (let c = 0; c < OLD.n; c++){ const f = OLD.cf[c]; let a = oldChunks.get(f); if (!a){ a = []; oldChunks.set(f, a); } a.push(c); }
    const NEW = emptyIndex();
    const copyOld = (oi, fid) => {
      const cs = oldChunks.get(oi) || [];
      if (!cs.length) return;
      const vecs = new Int8Array(cs.length * DIM), sigs = new Uint8Array(cs.length * SIG), locs = [], texts = [];
      cs.forEach((c, j) => { vecs.set(OLD.vec.subarray(c * DIM, c * DIM + DIM), j * DIM); sigs.set(OLD.sig.subarray(c * SIG, c * SIG + SIG), j * SIG); locs.push(OLD.cl[c]); texts.push(OLD.ct[c]); });
      addPassages(NEW, fid, locs, texts, vecs, sigs);
    };
    const keepOld = (key, fid) => {
      copyOld(oldBy.get(key), fid);
      for (const oi of oldInner.get(key) || []){ const nf = NEW.files.length; NEW.files.push({...OLD.files[oi]}); copyOld(oi, nf); }
    };
    const todo = [];
    let reused = 0;
    for (const it of work){
      const fid = NEW.files.length, key = ROOTS[it.ri].name + "\u0000" + it.path;
      NEW.files.push({p: it.path, s: it.file.size, m: it.file.lastModified, k: it.kind, r: it.ri});
      const oi = oldBy.get(key), of = oi !== undefined ? OLD.files[oi] : null;
      if (of && of.s === it.file.size && of.m === it.file.lastModified && of.k === it.kind){ keepOld(key, fid); reused++; }
      else { it.fid = fid; it.key = key; todo.push(it); }
    }
    /* small files first, so results show up soon; PDFs last */
    todo.sort((a, b) => (a.kind === "pdf") - (b.kind === "pdf") || a.file.size - b.file.size);

    const pool = await poolP;
    const totalBytes = todo.reduce((s, it) => s + it.file.size, 0) || 1;
    let doneBytes = 0, doneFiles = 0, lastUi = 0, slow = {ms: 0, path: ""}, inZip = 0;
    const gen = Date.now().toString(36);
    let savedTo = 0, lastSave = performance.now();
    const tStart = performance.now();
    const ui = it => {
      const now = performance.now();
      if (now - lastUi < 200) return; lastUi = now;
      const frac = doneBytes / totalBytes, el = (now - tStart) / 1000;
      progress(frac);
      log(fmt(doneFiles) + " of " + fmt(todo.length) + " files  \u00b7  " + fmt(NEW.n) + " passages  \u00b7  " +
          (frac > 0.02 && el > 2 ? "about " + fmtTime(el / frac - el) + " left" : "starting..."));
    };
    const embedPdf = async (w, bytes, path) => {
      let parts = [];
      try { parts = await pdfParts(bytes); } catch (e) { console.warn("pdf", path, e); }
      const msg = {t: "parts", parts, path};
      return w ? runJob(w, msg) : runLocal(msg);
    };
    let next = 0;
    const lane = async (w, pdfOnly) => {
      for (;;){
        if (STOP) return;
        let i = next;
        if (pdfOnly){ while (i < todo.length && todo[i].kind !== "pdf") i++; if (i >= todo.length) return; }
        else if (i >= todo.length) return;
        const it = todo[i];
        if (i === next) next++; else { todo.splice(i, 1); todo.splice(next, 0, it); next++; }
        ui(it);
        const tp = performance.now();
        let r;
        if (it.kind === "pdf") r = await embedPdf(w, new Uint8Array(await it.file.arrayBuffer()), it.path);
        else {
          const msg = {t: it.kind === "zip" || it.kind === "msg" ? "box" : "file", file: it.file, kind: it.kind, path: it.path};
          r = w ? await runJob(w, msg) : await runLocal(msg);
        }
        if (r.err) console.warn("could not read", it.path, r.err);
        if (it.kind === "zip" || it.kind === "msg"){
          if (r.main) addPassages(NEW, it.fid, r.main.locs, r.main.texts, r.main.vecs, r.main.sigs);
          for (const s of r.subs){ const nf = NEW.files.length; NEW.files.push({p: s.path, s: it.file.size, m: it.file.lastModified, k: s.kind, r: it.ri}); addPassages(NEW, nf, s.locs, s.texts, s.vecs, s.sigs); inZip++; }
          for (const p of r.pdfs){ const s = await embedPdf(w, p.bytes, p.path); const nf = NEW.files.length; NEW.files.push({p: p.path, s: it.file.size, m: it.file.lastModified, k: "pdf", r: it.ri}); addPassages(NEW, nf, s.locs, s.texts, s.vecs, s.sigs); inZip++; }
        } else addPassages(NEW, it.fid, r.locs, r.texts, r.vecs, r.sigs);
        doneBytes += it.file.size; doneFiles++;        const ms = performance.now() - tp;
        if (ms > slow.ms) slow = {ms, path: it.path};
        if (!w) await tick();
        if (performance.now() - lastSave > 30000){ lastSave = performance.now(); try { savedTo = await saveBatches(NEW, gen, savedTo); } catch (e) {} }
      }
    };
    const lanes = pool.size ? pool.workers.map(w => lane(w, false)) : [lane(null, false)];
    /* PDF.js works in its own workers: extra lanes keep those busy too */
    if (todo.some(it => it.kind === "pdf")){
      const P = await getPdf();
      for (let i = 0; i < P.n; i++) lanes.push(lane(pool.size ? pool.workers[i % pool.size] : null, true));
    }
    await Promise.all(lanes);

    if (STOP) for (const it of todo.slice(next)) if (oldBy.has(it.key)) keepOld(it.key, it.fid);
    NEW.at = Date.now();
    IX = NEW; await pinIndex(IX);
    progress(1);
    let saved = true;
    try { await saveBatches(IX, gen, savedTo); await saveMeta(IX, gen); } catch (e) { console.warn(e); saved = false; }
    const secs = (performance.now() - t0) / 1000;
    log((STOP ? "Stopped. " : "") + "Indexed " + fmt(IX.files.length) + " files in " + fmtTime(secs) + "." + (saved ? "" : " This browser did not save the index."));
  } catch (e) {
    console.error(e); log("Error: " + (e && e.message || e));
  } finally {
    BUSY = false; setBusy(false); updatePill(); renderRoots(); search();
  }
}

/* ---------- search ----------
   1. exact words: check each passage's 64-byte fingerprint; confirm hits in the text
   2. meaning: int8 vectors x query, in WebAssembly SIMD (or JavaScript), plus the word boost
   3. best passage of each file */
let RESULTS = [], SEL = 0, PIN = null;
/* copy the vectors into a WebAssembly memory once, after each index change */
async function pinIndex(ix){
  PIN = null;
  if (!MODEL.wasm || !ix.n) return;
  try {
    const X = await WebAssembly.instantiate(MODEL.wasm, {});
    const F = ix.files.length, n = ix.n;
    const vp = X.exports.alloc(n * DIM), cp = X.exports.alloc(n * 4), bp = X.exports.alloc(n * 4), qp = X.exports.alloc(DIM * 2), sp = X.exports.alloc(F * 4), ip = X.exports.alloc(F * 4);
    if (!vp || !cp || !bp || !qp || !sp || !ip) return;
    const mem = X.exports.memory.buffer;
    new Int8Array(mem, vp, n * DIM).set(ix.vec.subarray(0, n * DIM));
    new Int32Array(mem, cp, n).set(ix.cf);
    ix.vec = new Int8Array(mem, vp, n * DIM); ix.cap = n;          /* the JavaScript copy can go */
    PIN = {ix, X: X.exports, vp, cp, boost: new Int32Array(mem, bp, n), bp, q: new Int16Array(mem, qp, DIM), qp,
           bestS: new Int32Array(mem, sp, F), sp, bestC: new Int32Array(mem, ip, F), ip};
  } catch (e) { console.warn("search runs in JavaScript", e); PIN = null; }
}
function search(){
  const q = $("q").value.trim(), box = $("results");
  if (!q){ RESULTS = []; box.innerHTML = ROOTS.length ? "" : '<div class="empty">Add a folder to start.</div>'; return; }
  if (!IX.n){ box.innerHTML = '<div class="empty">Nothing is indexed yet.</div>'; return; }
  const N = IX.n, F = IX.files.length, pin = PIN && PIN.ix === IX ? PIN : null;
  const qv = E.embed(q);
  const boost = pin ? pin.boost : new Int32Array(N);
  boost.fill(0);
  /* exact words */
  const ws = [...new Set(E.words(q))], S = IX.sig, T = IX.ct;
  let anyBoost = false;
  if (ws.length){
    const lists = ws.map(w => {
      const [b0, m0, b1, m1, b2, m2] = E.wordBits(w), re = new RegExp(w.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\\/]/g, "\\$&"), "i"), hits = [];
      for (let c = 0, o = 0; c < N; c++, o += SIG) if ((S[o + b0] & m0) && (S[o + b1] & m1) && (S[o + b2] & m2) && re.test(T[c])) hits.push(c);
      return hits;
    });
    const norm = ws.length * Math.log(1 + N);
    lists.forEach(hits => {
      if (!hits.length) return;
      const w = Math.round(0.35 * 127 * 127 * Math.log(1 + N / hits.length) / norm);
      for (const c of hits) boost[c] += w;
      anyBoost = true;
    });
  }
  if (!qv && !anyBoost){ RESULTS = []; box.innerHTML = '<div class="empty">No match.</div>'; return; }
  let bestS, bestC;
  if (pin){
    for (let k = 0; k < DIM; k++) pin.q[k] = qv ? Math.round(qv[k] * 127) : 0;
    pin.bestS.fill(-2147483647);
    pin.X.scan(pin.vp, N, DIM, pin.qp, pin.bp, pin.cp, pin.sp, pin.ip);
    bestS = pin.bestS; bestC = pin.bestC;
  } else {
    const qi = new Int32Array(DIM); for (let k = 0; k < DIM; k++) qi[k] = qv ? Math.round(qv[k] * 127) : 0;
    const V = IX.vec, cf = IX.cf;
    bestS = new Int32Array(F).fill(-2147483647); bestC = new Int32Array(F);
    for (let c = 0, o = 0; c < N; c++, o += DIM){
      let s = boost[c];
      for (let k = 0; k < DIM; k += 8)
        s += V[o+k]*qi[k] + V[o+k+1]*qi[k+1] + V[o+k+2]*qi[k+2] + V[o+k+3]*qi[k+3] + V[o+k+4]*qi[k+4] + V[o+k+5]*qi[k+5] + V[o+k+6]*qi[k+6] + V[o+k+7]*qi[k+7];
      const f = cf[c];
      if (s > bestS[f]){ bestS[f] = s; bestC[f] = c; }
    }
  }
  let top = 0; for (let f = 0; f < F; f++) if (bestS[f] > top) top = bestS[f];
  const cut = Math.max(0.08 * 127 * 127, top * 0.45), list = [];
  for (let f = 0; f < F; f++) if (bestS[f] >= cut) list.push(f);
  list.sort((a, b) => bestS[b] - bestS[a]);
  RESULTS = list.slice(0, 50).map(f => ({f, c: bestC[f]}));
  SEL = 0;
  render(termsOf(q));
}
const STOPW = new Set("the and for how what with from that this are was were you your our not but can all any had has have into its may more one only out over such than then them they too very will about which when where who why does did doing done".split(" "));
function markRe(terms){
  const ws = terms.filter(t => t.length > 2 && !STOPW.has(t)).map(t => t.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\\/]/g, "\\$&")).sort((a, b) => b.length - a.length);
  return ws.length ? new RegExp("(?<![\\p{L}\\p{N}])(" + ws.join("|") + ")(?![\\p{L}\\p{N}])", "giu") : null;
}
function highlight(text, re){ return re ? esc(text).replace(re, "<mark>$1</mark>") : esc(text); }
/* show the part of the passage around the first match */
function around(text, re){
  if (!re) return text;
  re.lastIndex = 0; const m = re.exec(text); re.lastIndex = 0;
  if (!m || m.index < 60) return text;
  const i = text.lastIndexOf(" ", m.index - 50);
  return "..." + text.slice(i > 0 ? i : m.index - 50);
}
function render(terms){
  const box = $("results"), re = markRe(terms);
  if (!RESULTS.length){ box.innerHTML = '<div class="empty">No match.</div>'; return; }
  box.innerHTML = RESULTS.map((r, i) => {
    const f = IX.files[r.f], name = f.p.split("/").pop(), root = ROOTS[f.r] ? ROOTS[f.r].name : "";
    const loc = IX.cl[r.c];
    const locTxt = loc > 0 ? (f.k === "pptx" || f.k === "ppt" ? "slide " : f.k === "xlsx" || f.k === "xls" ? "sheet " : "page ") + loc : "";
    return '<div class="r' + (i === SEL ? " sel" : "") + '" data-i="' + i + '"><div class="top"><span class="name">' + highlight(name, re) +
      '</span><span class="loc">' + locTxt + '</span></div><div class="path">' + esc(root + "/" + f.p) + "</div>" +
      (loc === -1 ? "" : '<div class="snip">' + highlight(around(IX.ct[r.c], re), re) + "</div>") + "</div>";
  }).join("");
}
async function fileFor(f){
  const r = ROOTS[f.r];
  if (!r) return null;
  const z = f.p.indexOf("!/"), outer = z > 0 ? f.p.slice(0, z) : f.p;
  let file;
  if (r.files) file = r.files.get(outer) || null;
  else {
    if (!r.handle || !(await ensurePermission(r))) return null;
    let h = r.handle; const segs = outer.split("/");
    for (let i = 0; i < segs.length - 1; i++) h = await h.getDirectoryHandle(segs[i]);
    file = await (await h.getFileHandle(segs[segs.length - 1])).getFile();
  }
  if (!file || z < 0) return file;
  const inner = f.p.slice(z + 2), bytes = await E.boxItem(file, E.kindOf(outer.split("/").pop()), inner);
  if (!bytes) return null;
  const types = {pdf: "application/pdf", txt: "text/plain", md: "text/plain", csv: "text/plain"};
  return new File([bytes], inner.split("/").pop(), {type: types[E.extOf(inner)] || (f.k === "code" ? "text/plain" : "application/octet-stream")});
}
async function act(i, a){
  const r = RESULTS[i]; if (!r) return;
  const f = IX.files[r.f];
  if (a === "copy"){
    const p = (ROOTS[f.r] ? ROOTS[f.r].name : "") + "/" + f.p;
    try { await navigator.clipboard.writeText(p); toast("Copied " + p); } catch (e) { prompt("Copy this path:", p); }
    return;
  }
  try {
    let file = await fileFor(f);
    if (!file){ toast("This file is not available now. Press Update to get access again."); return; }
    if (f.k === "code" && !file.type) file = new File([file], file.name, {type: "text/plain"});
    const loc = IX.cl[r.c];
    window.open(URL.createObjectURL(file) + (f.k === "pdf" && loc > 0 ? "#page=" + loc : ""), "_blank");
  } catch (e) { toast("Cannot open this file: " + (e.message || e)); }
}

/* ---------- UI ---------- */
function log(t){ $("plog").textContent = t; }
function progress(x){ $("pbar").style.width = x >= 1 ? "0" : (Math.max(0, x) * 100).toFixed(1) + "%"; }
function setBusy(b){ $("go").textContent = b ? "Stop" : "Update"; $("go").disabled = !b && !ROOTS.length; $("add").disabled = b; }
function updatePill(){ $("pill").textContent = IX.n ? fmt(IX.files.length) + " files" : ""; }
function renderRoots(){
  $("roots").innerHTML = ROOTS.map((r, i) => '<span class="root" title="' + (!r.handle && !r.files ? "Add this folder again to update it" : "") + '">' + esc(r.name) +
    '<button data-rm="' + i + '" title="Remove">&times;</button></span>').join(" ");
  $("roots").querySelectorAll("button[data-rm]").forEach(b => b.onclick = () => removeRoot(+b.dataset.rm));
  setBusy(BUSY);
}
async function removeRoot(i){
  if (BUSY) return;
  const keep = IX.files.map(f => f.r !== i), newId = []; let k = 0;
  IX.files.forEach((f, j) => { newId[j] = keep[j] ? k++ : -1; });
  const old = IX, ix = emptyIndex();
  ix.files = old.files.filter((f, j) => keep[j]).map(f => ({...f, r: f.r > i ? f.r - 1 : f.r}));
  for (let c = 0; c < old.n; c++){ const nf = newId[old.cf[c]]; if (nf >= 0) addPassages(ix, nf, [old.cl[c]], [old.ct[c]], old.vec.subarray(c * DIM, c * DIM + DIM), old.sig.subarray(c * SIG, c * SIG + SIG)); }
  ix.at = old.at; IX = ix;
  ROOTS.splice(i, 1);
  await pinIndex(IX); renderRoots(); updatePill(); search(); await saveAll(IX);
}
async function addRoot(){
  if (window.showDirectoryPicker){
    try {
      const h = await window.showDirectoryPicker({id: "babydig", mode: "read"});
      const same = ROOTS.findIndex(r => r.name === h.name);
      if (same >= 0) ROOTS[same].handle = h; else ROOTS.push({name: h.name, handle: h, base: ""});
      renderRoots(); saveRoots(); runIndex();
    } catch (e) { if (e.name !== "AbortError") toast(e.message); }
  } else $("dirf").click();
}
$("dirf").onchange = () => {
  const fl = [...$("dirf").files]; if (!fl.length) return;
  const name = fl[0].webkitRelativePath.split("/")[0], m = new Map();
  for (const f of fl) m.set(f.webkitRelativePath.split("/").slice(1).join("/"), f);
  const same = ROOTS.findIndex(r => r.name === name);
  if (same >= 0) ROOTS[same].files = m; else ROOTS.push({name, handle: null, base: "", files: m});
  $("dirf").value = ""; renderRoots(); saveRoots(); runIndex();
};
$("add").onclick = addRoot;
$("go").onclick = () => { if (BUSY){ STOP = true; log("Stopping..."); } else runIndex(); };

let qt = 0;
$("q").addEventListener("input", () => { clearTimeout(qt); qt = setTimeout(search, 60); });
$("results").addEventListener("click", e => { const r = e.target.closest(".r"); if (r) act(+r.dataset.i, e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey ? "copy" : "open"); });
function markSel(){ document.querySelectorAll(".r").forEach(el => el.classList.toggle("sel", +el.dataset.i === SEL)); const s = document.querySelector(".r.sel"); if (s) s.scrollIntoView({block: "nearest"}); }
document.addEventListener("keydown", e => {
  if (!RESULTS.length) return;
  if (e.key === "ArrowDown"){ e.preventDefault(); SEL = Math.min(RESULTS.length - 1, SEL + 1); markSel(); }
  else if (e.key === "ArrowUp"){ e.preventDefault(); SEL = Math.max(0, SEL - 1); markSel(); }
  else if (e.key === "Enter"){ e.preventDefault(); act(SEL, (e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) ? "copy" : "open"); }
});
